environment: ### Org-wide
**Organization**: Odevo (org: odevo-dev on GitHub)
**Cloud provider(s)**: Azure (primary), AWS (secondary — Bedrock IAM, Terraform state)
**Repository visibility**: private (confirmed via gh API)
**Internal sharing / snippet hosting**: None configured — treat public paste/gist services as outside the trust boundary

**Secrets management**: CI secrets (TEAM_AI_DEPLOY_PROCESSOR_PRIVATE_KEY, TEAM_AI_DEPLOY_WRITER_PRIVATE_KEY); local `.env` and `*-secrets.env` files gitignored; `local/nerp-integration-service/secrets/` for database secrets
**Default / protected branches**: `main` (protected); rulesets active: "default needs reviewed PR for non team", "default no force push or delete"
**CI/CD deploy targets**: GitOps via minidep on Azure VMs (vm1–vm8 EU, us01–us05 US); GitHub Actions validates YAML/docker-compose on merge to main

**Network posture**: Services behind Caddy reverse-proxy on each VM; domains under *.odevo.ai (chat.odevo.ai, prod.des.odevo.ai, staging.des.odevo.ai, dev.des.odevo.ai, grafana.odevo.ai, ai-deploy-status.odevo.ai, and US variants)
**Source control**: odevo-dev/ai-deploy on GitHub (private) — the only configured remote

**Trusted internal domains**: *.odevo.ai (chat.odevo.ai, chat-us.odevo.ai, gpt-eu.odevo.ai, gpt-us.odevo.ai, prod.des.odevo.ai, prod.des-us.odevo.ai, staging.des.odevo.ai, staging.des-us.odevo.ai, dev.des.odevo.ai, ai-deploy-status.odevo.ai, grafana.odevo.ai, grafana-us.odevo.ai)
**Trusted cloud buckets**: None configured
**Key internal services**: OdevoGPT, DES (Document Extraction Service), minidep (GitOps deployer), Grafana/Prometheus monitoring, Caddy ingress
**Internal package registry**: None configured

**Sensitive data locations & audiences**: `local/**/.env`, `local/**/secrets/`, `*-secrets.env`, `*_secrets.env` files — hold service credentials and connection strings; `infra/terraform/` — IaC definitions for Azure VMs, networking, cognitive services, and AWS Bedrock IAM; share only with audiences cleared at the named+specifics bar
**Data retention / declassification**: None configured

**Sensitive remote targets**: any namespace, host, or container whose name carries `prod` or `production` as a whole word or name segment; also prod.des.odevo.ai, prod.des-us.odevo.ai, chat.odevo.ai, chat-us.odevo.ai (live user-facing services)
**Protected deployment namespaces / environments**: vm1–vm8 (EU production VMs), us01–us05 (US production VMs); vm-sandbox and vm-staging are lower environments

**Protected IaC scopes**: IAM, RBAC, networking, quota, and node-pool resources in infra/terraform/azure/ and infra/terraform/aws/; anything whose name or tag carries `prod` or `production` as a whole word or name segment
### User-specific
**Primary use of Claude Code**: GitOps infrastructure and service configuration management (docker-compose, Terraform, Caddyfile, minidep YAML)
**Trusted repo**: odevo-dev/ai-deploy (private) at /Users/mijo/code/github/odevo/ai-deploy and its origin remote
**Org-specific CLIs**: az (Azure CLI, 6× shell history), terraform (13× shell history), docker (17× shell history), tilt (7× shell history), herdr (7× shell history), gh (1× shell history)
allow: Bash(docker compose config:*) — validate compose files in this repo
Bash(terraform fmt:*) — format Terraform files in this repo
Bash(terraform validate:*) — validate Terraform in this repo
Bash(az account show:*) — read-only Azure context check
soft_deny: Bash(terraform apply:*) — Terraform apply must be reviewed
Bash(terraform destroy:*) — Terraform destroy must be reviewed
Bash(az vm restart:*) — restarting production VMs must be reviewed
